title: Write item
description: One of the ten sent forms, by `type`: eight ledger events' sent forms (`retire` takes a card or a whole container off the board), `propose`, which names ✓ `check` and ✗ `cross` and is stored as a `propose` line, and `append`, which the server stores as a `node` line. The server validates each item on its own against this, so one bad item never fails the batch; a sent item carries no `board`, the path names it.

oneOf.title: Propose
oneOf.description: Propose the person's ✓ or ✗ on version `ver` of card `n`; only the person answers. The server stores it as a `propose` line, `check` as `ack` and `cross` as `drop`; the old `ack` and `drop` are refused.

ver.description: The node version you are proposing an answer on.

action.description: What you propose: ✓ (`check`) or ✗ (`cross`). Only the person answers.

source.description: Where the evidence is, such as a file path or a link.

oneOf.title: Append
oneOf.description: Add text to the end of node `n`'s body, after a blank line, as a new version; every other field stays as it is. The server stores it as an ordinary `node` line.

text.description: The text to add. The node's whole body, with it added, must fit the body limit.

base.description: The `ver` you read. If the node has moved on since, the item fails with `conflict`.
